_change_rule: Measured values change only with a re-measurement recorded in CHANGELOG.md.
_measured: 2026-11-06, Claude cloud session: opus-5-5 sub-agent held 437,683 tok (28/28 canaries) and compacted silently at ~790,000; fable-5-1 held 439,419; sonnet-5-5 compacted silently at ~390,000; sub-agent baseline ~72,000 tok; 215,068 B of spec = 89,041 tok. Proof run (SSC_CGL_TIER2 paper 3, 50 questions, 6 workers): a worker after its full read 480,000-500,000 tok; one batch 28,000-118,000; the Final Assembly sweep ~160,000; largest worker 642,000, no compaction.
_read_growth: 2026.12.02 (GAP-2026-11-23-TOKEN-TELEMETRY, Phase 1B — G7; audit_specs_ext SPEC-READ-GROWTH): the FINAL read each routed trigger serves (sum of SPEC_SECTIONS final_read_bytes), measured at release 2026.12.02. A release may grow a read by at most read_growth_tolerance_bytes (~1,000 tokens); more needs this baseline raised in the same commit with the owner decision in CHANGELOG.md. A release that cuts a read lowers its baseline.
_worker_models: OD-2026-11-23-OPUS-ONLY (release 2026.11.30): owner decision — every Step 7 sub-agent (worker, standby, reviewer, adjudicator, _switch re-ask) runs on Opus only; fable removed (it reached its usage limit mid-run and is the costlier model). Reviewer / adjudicator independence = fresh context + blind packet (Orchestrate O6-1). Orchestrate v1.13.0 O2-2: never a model outside this list.
_speed: GAP-2026-11-13-STEP7-SPEED (release 2026.11.15). Initial values, to be re-measured by the timed proof run and recorded in CHANGELOG.md (_change_rule). fa_work_unit_tokens: the measured Final Assembly sweep (~160,000, _measured) - the room a worker needs to run Final Assembly itself (Orchestrate O2-5). review_qs_per_job: questions (units) per fresh reviewer job (blueprint_core.bv_job_chunks). parallel_jobs_max: sub-agents the orchestrator starts in one wave. *_minutes_target: a window over its target writes one FRAMEWORK NOTE (bootstrap --timing-show) - never a stop. max_batches_per_worker is no longer a Step 7 rotation rule (Orchestrate O2-5 v1.7.0: room decides). 2026.11.16 (GAP-2026-11-14-BATCH-COMPLETE, OD-2026-11-14 R6): Final Assembly is deterministic (byte copy, sweep, commit, two files; no sub-agent), so fa_work_unit_tokens is an INITIAL 60,000 — to be measured by the timed proof run (GAP §10.3) and recorded in CHANGELOG.md; the *_minutes_target values stay until that run measures them (no minute target is published before it).
_project_inputs: Measured 2026-11-06: on a surface without /mnt/project the Projects tool returns documents INLINE (seen up to ~300,000 chars), each one read costs the chat that much context. For the triggers listed here input staging reads only the project documents the step opens; audit_specs_ext SPEC-CAPACITY fails the build when a routed spec names a /mnt/project file that no pattern here matches. Unlisted triggers stage every document.
